title: International Property Listings Seized at €595,000 Across Ireland, Sweden, Italy, and Portugal
text: International Property Listings Seized at €595,000 Across Ireland, Sweden, Italy, and Portugal A curated selection of international real estate offers diverse living experiences, ranging from a restored A-rated home in West Cork to a ski-accessible residence in Sweden, a renovated historic apartment in Palermo, and a luxury penthouse in the Algarve, all priced at €595,000. West Cork: Bere Island The construction of Seahaven on Bere Island in west Cork, which was completed earlier this year, included the restoration of an original building with the addition of a substantial extension to create a four-bedroom, A-rated property. It is set on 1.3 acres with views over Lonehort Harbour and Bantry Bay. Inside is an open-plan living, kitchen and dining area with vaulted ceiling and handmade stone fireplace. There is also a utility room and four en-suite bedrooms, and it comes with high-speed broadband. Price €595,000 Agent Savills Sweden: Tannas Tannas in northern Sweden is known for its skiing, with trails running close to this traditional Scandinavian home.It has a floor area of 218sq m and has been designed with high ceilings and expansive windows. It has a large kitchen and livingroom with doors out to a patio. There is a bathroom with sauna and an external heated room for ski gear. Upstairs are three bedrooms and a bathroom.Price €595,000 Agent lindbergetmakleri.se Italy: Palermo In the centre of Palermo is this colourful apartment that has been recently renovated and comes fully furnished. It is on the first floor of a historic building and has two levels connected by a staircase and private elevator. The main floor has a kitchen with balcony, three bedrooms and two bathrooms. Upstairs is a second bathroom and a livingroom that opens out to a private terrace with views out to Porta Nuova.Price €595,000 Agent savills.com Portugal: Algarve This three-bedroom penthouse within the Amendoeira Golf Resort has views over the courses. It has a floor area of 142sq m and is designed for year-round use with air conditioning and underfloor heating. It is set out over two levels and has three en-suite bedrooms, and open-plan living, dining and kitchen area, two balconies and a rooftop terrace. The resort has 24-hour security, a sports centre, two restaurants and a bar.Price €595,000 Agent engelvoelkers.com Greece: Myknonos This holiday villa 9km from Mykonos town was recently renovated. It has 90sq m of accommodation over two floors as well as a private swimming pool and deck. There is a living, dining and kitchen area on the first floor that opens out to a large balcony with sea views. On the ground floor are two bedrooms and a bathroom.Kalafatis beach, one of the quieter beaches on the island, is within walking distance. Price €595,000 Agent savills.gr
